name: Finolex Industries Ltd
title: Finolex Industries Ltd - 500940 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 EBITDA nearly doubled to INR332 crore on flat volumes (101,772 t) helped by inventory gains of INR35-40 crore; management guides FY27 margin sub-15% and volume growth higher single to lower double digit, with agri demand soft.

utilisation.quote: Current year, we have the capacity of 5,20,000. So based on that, our utilization is 67%.

capex.quote: every year, we are going to incur the capex of roughly around INR100-odd crores every year. This is more on account of our maintenance capex

triggers.label: Agri volume down, April subdued
triggers.quote: April was pretty subdued, but we see a little better May.

triggers.label: FY27 margin target sub-15%
triggers.quote: we have a target to sub-15 level roughly somewhere around.

guidance.value: higher single digit to lower double digit
guidance.quote: we are targeting a growth number of roughly around higher single digit to double -- lower double digit.
we have a target to maintain our EBITDA margin on a mid- to lower double digits

red_flags.label: Margin flattered by inventory gains; guide cut to sub-15%
red_flags.quote: the kind of margin that we have -- you have seen during the current quarter is obviously certain at the higher side, but going to be -- going forward, it is going to moderate to some extent.

red_flags.label: Cash deployment undecided, no buyback/dividend policy
red_flags.quote: the decision regarding the remaining cash is yet to come. So we'll have to see.
